Indian cricket team faces scrutiny after series of defeats

The Indian T20 cricket team is at a critical juncture following a series of defeats. Captain Shreyas Iyer has called the batting performance unacceptable, and head coach Gautam Gambhir has described the current phase as a vital 'reset' amidst lineup changes. The team's approach to batting and adaptation is under scrutiny.
